say:1:1732204901:1.text: I've got nothing! All my sources are gone!
say:1:1732204901:1.source_cn: 没有没有！我之前好不容易编织的情报网全失效了！
say:1:1732204901:1.male: I've got nothing! All my sources are gone!
say:1:1732204901:1.female: I've got nothing! All my sources are gone!

say:2:1732204902:1.text: Maybe I should be asking you for information now!
say:2:1732204902:1.source_cn: 现在我的听不到也看不到，或许情报还没你知道的多！
say:2:1732204902:1.male: Maybe I should be asking you for information now!
say:2:1732204902:1.female: Maybe I should be asking you for information now!

say:3:1732204903:1.text: Don't lose heart, buddy. We can always find new sources...
say:3:1732204903:1.source_cn: 别丧气兄弟，我们可以重建情报网……
say:3:1732204903:1.male: Don't lose heart, buddy. We can always find new sources...
say:3:1732204903:1.female: Don't lose heart, buddy. We can always find new sources...

say:4:1732204904:1.text: That's going to make a serious dent in my savings! Oh, my money!
say:4:1732204904:1.source_cn: 那得花多少银币啊！我的银币啊！
say:4:1732204904:1.male: That's going to make a serious dent in my savings! Oh, my money!
say:4:1732204904:1.female: That's going to make a serious dent in my savings! Oh, my money!
